record.question: He ___________ asleep while he was driving.
record.explanation: Answer C: fell. “Fell asleep” gives a completed event during the past continuous background “was driving”. The other two offered forms do not fit that past-time relation. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
